# directus_settings (Data Source)

Reads the Directus project settings singleton.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `custom_css` (String) Custom CSS.
- `default_appearance` (String) Default appearance.
- `default_language` (String) Default language.
- `default_theme_dark` (String) Default dark theme.
- `default_theme_light` (String) Default light theme.
- `id` (Number) Settings id.
- `mapbox_key` (String) Mapbox key.
- `module_bar` (String) Module bar configuration.
- `project_color` (String) Project color.
- `project_descriptor` (String) Project descriptor.
- `project_logo` (String) Project logo file UUID.
- `project_name` (String) Project name.
- `project_url` (String) Project URL.
- `public_registration` (Boolean) Public registration enabled.
- `public_registration_verify_email` (Boolean) Public registration email verification.
- `report_bug_url` (String) Report bug URL.
- `report_error_url` (String) Report error URL.
- `storage_asset_transform` (String) Asset transform policy.
